evidence_boundary: This qualification is a downstream algebraic and trajectory-conformance decision conditional on valid PASS records for WP1Q-N3BP-v1 and WP2KSQ-v1. It covers positive finite masses, collision-free source states, exact canonical momenta p_i=m_i*v_i, the generic non-collinear SO(3) chart, explicitly classified collinear singular strata, and the frozen N3BP source trajectories and random structural bounds.
